keyEvents.text: Atakan Karazor (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Mario Lemina (Galatasaray).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Stuttgart 0. Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Goal! Galatasaray 2, Stuttgart 0. Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Davinson Sánchez.
Delay in match because of an injury Atakan Karazor (Stuttgart).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Yanik Spalt replaces Atakan Karazor because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray).
Deniz Undav (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card.
Baris Alper Yilmaz (Galatasaray) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
